00CAAC.note: damage from a weapon hit: a5 = the target, d0 = the damage that $00B7B2 takes off its armour ($2C(a5) at $00B7C4), a4 = the weapon entry (its damage at +8); the host scales it for the difficulty. Crashes and other damage reach $00B7B2 from other callers and are left alone

00D880.why: strafe (strafe button, A by default) speed in the flight model at $00D830: sideways velocity = strafe state x 0x159 on the Genesis; the Strafe Speed setting scales it. Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

00DADE.why: strafe speed in the flight model at $00DA8E (x 0x159 on the Genesis); the Strafe Speed setting scales it. Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

00DD9C.why: strafe sideways thrust, one way, in the flight model at $00DD94: 0xC00 on the Genesis, as Desert's $00CA4E. Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

00DDBA.why: strafe sideways thrust, the other way (-0xC00 on the Genesis). Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

00F438.note: a projectile is fired (a0 the shooter, a3 its weapon record; the reload time was just set): the host rumbles for the player's weapons, unlimited ammo or not
